features.description: Read deny rules now apply to files @-mentioned, changed or selected in the IDE through a symlink.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed `Read` deny rules not applying to files @-mentioned, changed, or selected in the IDE through a symlink
features.ork_disposition_note: Free upside for the Read() deny rules in ork's operator payload. Recorded in the doctor matrix row for 2.1.289 (#4662).

features.description: Bash deny and ask rules no longer miss a command behind an env var prefix with an expanded value when the sandbox auto-allows commands.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed Bash deny and ask rules missing a command behind an environment variable prefix with an expanded value (e.g. `TZ="$HOME" rm -rf build`) when the sandbox auto-allows commands
features.ork_disposition_note: Follow-up: run ork's operator deny payload against the env-prefix form (e.g. TZ="$HOME" rm -rf build); the doctor row names the check, it has not been run.

features.description: A Bash deny or ask rule is no longer skipped under sandbox auto-allow when a bare variable assignment comes before the command.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed a Bash deny or ask rule being skipped under sandbox auto-allow when a bare variable assignment came before the command
features.ork_disposition_note: Same class as the env-prefix fix; free upside for the Bash(rm -rf ...) denies in the operator payload.

features.description: Installed mods now load in the first session after a Claude Code upgrade.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed installed mods not loading in the first session after an upgrade
features.ork_disposition_note: Before 2.1.289 secrets-veil masking and lesson-cards were absent in the first session after an upgrade; free upside for ork's four mods.

features.description: agent.spawn for teammates, one agent id across plugin hook events, and idle and waiting states in $.agent.list().
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `agent.spawn` for teammates, one agent id across plugin hook events, and idle and waiting states in `$.agent.list()`
features.ork_disposition_note: Follow-up: re-measure whether pre-compact-guard.ts still needs its duplicate agent_id 'start' row dedup once ids are stable across hook events.

features.description: A value a mod's ui.render hook wrote that makes a row throw no longer ends the session; the engine draws its own row.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed sessions ending with "unrecoverable interface error" when a value a mod's `ui.render` hook wrote made a row throw while drawn; the engine now draws its own row instead
features.ork_disposition_note: Free resilience upside for lesson-cards (ui.render on ToolUse rows).

features.description: Supervised and background sessions no longer end when a plugin's on-screen handler throws asynchronously.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed supervised and background sessions ending when a plugin's on-screen handler threw asynchronously
features.ork_disposition_note: Free resilience upside for promote-lights (async ui.render and clock.every handlers).

features.description: claude plugin validate no longer skips the plugin when the folder also holds a marketplace manifest.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed `claude plugin validate` skipping the plugin when the folder also holds a marketplace manifest
features.ork_disposition_note: ork's validate job targets the marketplace manifest and plugins/ork holds no marketplace.json, so the skipped case never applied.

features.description: A deny or ask rule on a nested part of a compound shell command now holds over a user-installed mod's approval on managed machines.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed a deny or ask rule on a nested part of a compound shell command not holding over a user-installed mod's approval on managed machines
features.ork_disposition_note: No ork mod approves tool calls (secrets-veil masks results after next(e)); nothing to change.

features.description: The WebSearch budget refills 100 calls per hour instead of a hard 200 per session; CLAUDE_CODE_WEB_SEARCH_REFILLS_PER_HOUR sets the rate, 0 turns it off.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed the interactive session's WebSearch budget to refill over time (100 calls/hour; `CLAUDE_CODE_WEB_SEARCH_REFILLS_PER_HOUR` sets the rate, 0 turns it off) instead of ending after 200 calls
features.ork_disposition_note: Documented in configure/references/cc-version-settings.md (the 2.1.290 matrix row named this doc adoption but the section was missing).

features.description: Bash permission checks now ask for read-only commands whose wildcard arguments the shell expands (rg, git grep).
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed Bash permission checks auto-approving some read-only commands (such as `rg` or `git grep`) whose arguments the shell would still expand as wildcards; these now prompt for approval
features.ork_disposition_note: Probed 2026-10-08 on 2.1.294 (matrix row): a headless wildcard git grep is denied, a plain one runs. Follow-up: unattended callers that glob rg need an allow rule; re-run the operator payload coverage test.

features.description: Permission rules and safety checks now apply to a tool call after a PreToolUse hook rewrote its input.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed some permission rules and safety checks not being applied to a tool call after a PreToolUse hook rewrote its input
features.ork_disposition_note: ork's headless-responder and write-edit dispatcher return updatedInput, so allow and deny rules now see the rewritten form. Probed PASS with a generic rewrite hook; follow-up: test the RTK rewrite form.

features.description: In-process teammate agent_id is now the agent ID (name@team moves to teammate_id) and TeammateIdle no longer fires from a teammate's subagents or forks.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed an in-process teammate's `agent_id` in Agent results to its agent ID (its `name@team` address stays in `teammate_id`); TeammateIdle hooks no longer fire from its subagents or forks
features.ork_disposition_note: Follow-up: ork registers TeammateIdle hooks that count idle events; the 2026-10-08 probe was INCONCLUSIVE and needs an interactive agent team.

features.description: claude plugin validate lists each gating-site mod hook and whether it has a .catch (gatingHooks in JSON output).
features.reference_changelog_line: Added to `claude plugin validate`: each hook a mod registers at a gating site is listed with whether it has a `.catch` (`gatingHooks` under `--json`)
features.ork_disposition_note: Follow-up (mods code): run validate in JSON mode on ork's mods and add .catch to the tool.call guards it lists without one. Not in this PR (runtime code).

features.description: WebFetch no longer drops text past 100k characters; it reports the unread amount and takes an offset.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed WebFetch silently dropping page text past 100,000 characters; it now says how much was unread and takes an `offset` to read on
features.ork_disposition_note: Free upside for research agents that fetch long pages.

features.description: Background agents no longer fail with Agent stalled, and Workflow subagents no longer restart, after the Mac sleeps.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed background agents failing with "Agent stalled" and Workflow tool subagents restarting from their prompt when a Mac woke from sleep
features.ork_disposition_note: Free upside for ork's Workflow fan-out skills on laptops.

features.description: Background subagents keep write and Bash access in their worktree when the main session switches worktree.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed background subagents losing write and Bash access in their worktree after the main session enters or exits a different worktree
features.ork_disposition_note: Free upside for ork's 25 isolation: worktree agents.

features.description: Skills are found by their SKILL.md name when the folder name differs.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed skills not being found when asked for by the name in SKILL.md when their folder has a different name (for example a non-English name): the skill listing now shows both names
features.ork_disposition_note: Every ork SKILL.md name matches its folder (changelog watch scan: 0 of 110 differ).

features.description: The Bash tool now asks before running pyright (no longer treated as read-only).
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed the Bash tool to ask for permission before running `pyright`, which is no longer treated as a read-only command
features.ork_disposition_note: No ork hook or headless harness runs pyright through the Bash tool.

features.description: 2.1.288 could lose the last messages of a session on quit, and 2.1.290 could drop cloud permission answers; both fixed.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed a regression in 2.1.288 where the last messages of a session could be lost when quitting
features.ork_disposition_note: The doctor matrix row for 2.1.291 says never to set supported_floor inside 2.1.288 to 2.1.290; recorded again in the cc-support.json override note.

features.description: The Agent tool takes an effort parameter, so one subagent can run at a named effort.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added an `effort` parameter to the Agent tool, so Claude runs a sub-agent at the effort level you ask for
features.ork_disposition_note: Follow-up: effort-scaled skills could pass effort per spawn instead of per session (relates to #4052 and #4051). The spawn guard reads subagent_type only, so the extra key is harmless today.

features.description: claude plugin install takes a marketplace source and adds the marketplace before installing, in one command.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `--marketplace <source>` to `claude plugin install`: adds the marketplace if needed, under the same policy checks as `claude plugin marketplace add`, then installs the plugin from it
features.ork_disposition_note: Follow-up (docs): collapse ork's two-step install instructions into one command once the floor reaches 2.1.292; the floor is 2.1.277, so both forms stay documented for now.

features.description: Local (stdio) MCP servers negotiate protocol 2026-07-28 by default; MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy opts out; slow servers are remembered for 7 days.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed local (stdio) MCP server connections to negotiate protocol version 2026-07-28 by default on every install, including Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry; `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy` opts out
features.ork_disposition_note: Documented in configure/references/cc-version-settings.md. Probed 2026-10-08: server/discover first, fallback to initialize 2025-11-25 (matrix row).

features.description: <system-reminder> tags written in hook output are escaped before they reach Claude.
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved hook output handling: `<system-reminder>` tags written in a hook's output are escaped before they reach Claude
features.ork_disposition_note: Follow-up (hook code): lifecycle/ask-fallback-injector.ts wraps its text in a literal system-reminder tag (ORK_ASK_FALLBACK=text); on 2.1.292+ Claude sees it escaped. Drop the wrapper; not in this PR (runtime code).

features.description: CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS sets a longer base delay for 529 retries.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS` environment variable to set a longer base delay for the backoff when retrying an overloaded (529) request
features.ork_disposition_note: Documented in configure/references/cc-version-settings.md beside the 2.1.296 max-delay variable.

features.description: One-shot claude -p now waits for background commands and scheduled wakeups instead of stopping them after 5 s.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed one-shot `claude -p` and Agent SDK runs stopping a background command 5 seconds after the final result, and one-shot `claude -p` runs dropping a scheduled wakeup; both are now waited for
features.ork_disposition_note: Follow-up: ork's headless harnesses (bare-eval, ci-sentinel) may take longer to exit when a run starts a background command; watch their wall time.

features.description: A mod hook that called next(e) and then failed during an interrupted turn now rejects the call.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed a mod's hook that called `next(e)` and then failed while the turn was interrupted letting the call through; the call is now rejected
features.ork_disposition_note: Follow-up: a throw in secrets-veil after next(e) now rejects the call instead of passing unmasked output; confirm the masking path never throws.

features.description: An MCP tool with a name over 128 characters is dropped with a named error instead of failing every request.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed an MCP tool with a name longer than 128 characters making every request fail; that tool is now left out and an MCP error names it
features.ork_disposition_note: ork ships no MCP server, so no ork tool name is at risk.

features.description: Claude Haiku 5.5 is the default Haiku model on the Anthropic API (1M context, $0.10/$0.50 per MTok); adaptive thinking, rejects sampling parameters and prefill.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added Claude Haiku 5.5 (`claude-haiku-5-5`), now the default Haiku model on the Anthropic API — 1M context, $0.10/$0.50 per Mtok ($0.50/$2.50 for prompts over 100K)
features.ork_disposition_note: Follow-up in flight: #4660 (vocab and pricing row) and #4661 (alias), both OPEN on 2026-10-10. Claude Code's own haiku alias already resolves to Haiku 5.5 (probe 2026-10-08).

features.description: claude plugin eval no longer refuses every Bash-granting run on Macs with Docker Desktop links.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed `claude plugin eval` refusing every Bash-granting run on Macs with Docker Desktop (links under `~/.docker/bin`); the refusal now names which part of a credential store held the link
features.ork_disposition_note: Probed PASS 2026-10-08 on 2.1.294 (matrix row).

features.description: Path-scoped rules and nested CLAUDE.md now load when Claude reads a file through cat, head, tail, sed -n or grep in Bash.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed path-scoped rules and nested CLAUDE.md files not loading when Claude views a file with a single-file cat, head, tail, sed -n or grep command in the Bash tool instead of the Read tool
features.ork_disposition_note: Follow-up: ork ships path-scoped rules; InstructionsLoaded may fire more often in Bash-heavy sessions; check rules-size-check for noise.

features.description: An HTTP MCP connection no longer keeps every sent request in memory until close.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed a memory leak where an HTTP MCP connection kept every request it had sent until it closed
features.ork_disposition_note: Free upside for long sessions with HTTP MCP servers.

features.description: agentType is added to the subagentStatusLine payload.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `agentType` to the `subagentStatusLine` payload, so scripts can tell custom subagent types apart
features.ork_disposition_note: ork ships no subagentStatusLine.

features.description: prompt and agent hooks written as instructions no longer allow what they should block.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed `prompt` and `agent` hooks written as instructions (such as "Block commands that...") allowing what they should block
features.ork_disposition_note: ork ships no prompt or agent type hook (0 in src/hooks/hooks.json); recorded in the 2.1.294 matrix row.

features.description: prompt hooks on Stop and SubagentStop written as instructions are judged so Claude is less likely to stop early.
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved how `prompt` hooks on Stop and SubagentStop written as instructions (such as "Carry on if the build is broken") are judged, so Claude is less likely to stop early
features.ork_disposition_note: ork's Stop hooks are command hooks; unaffected.

features.description: Command and HTTP hooks take onFailure: "block": a hook that cannot start, times out or exits with an unexpected code blocks the action. The default still lets the action through.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `onFailure: "block"` for command and HTTP hooks: a hook that can't start, times out, or exits with an unexpected code blocks the action instead of letting it through
features.ork_disposition_note: Documented in configure/references/cc-version-settings.md. Follow-up (hooks.json): 0 of 152 ork hook entries set onFailure; add "block" to the security guard hooks only, never to telemetry hooks, once the floor reaches 2.1.295. Not in this PR (runtime config).

features.description: MCP tool descriptions the model loads through tool search are cut at 16,384 characters instead of 2,048.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed MCP tool descriptions the model loads through tool search to be cut at 16,384 characters instead of 2,048
features.ork_disposition_note: Documented in configure/references/cc-version-settings.md with the 2.1.296 up-front cap.

features.description: CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_WAIT_MS limits how long unattended retry mode waits out 429 and 529 errors.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_WAIT_MS` to limit how long unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) waits out 429 and 529 errors
features.ork_disposition_note: Documented in configure/references/cc-version-settings.md. Follow-up (docs): bare-eval tells overnight batches to set CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG=1; name the cap there too.

features.description: A skill's allowed-tools and effort are no longer dropped when the Skill tool finishes before the response stream ends, which denied the skill's Bash commands in -p runs.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed a skill's `allowed-tools` and `effort` being dropped when the Skill tool finished before the response stream ended, which denied the skill's Bash commands in `-p` runs
features.ork_disposition_note: Upside for headless runs of ork skills; 43 ork skills set effort in frontmatter, so headless cost and latency may shift. Watch eval wall time.

features.description: Forked skills invoked from Workflow subagents return their results to the invoking agent instead of the main conversation.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed forked skills invoked from Workflow subagents delivering their results to the main conversation instead of the invoking agent
features.ork_disposition_note: Free upside for ork's Workflow fan-out skills.

features.description: The Workflow tool's scriptPath refusal now says to pass the script inline; scriptPath needs a Read tool.
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved the Workflow tool's `scriptPath` refusal: it now says to pass the script inline via `script`, the route that works in sessions without a Read tool
features.ork_disposition_note: Follow-up: 6 ork SKILL.md files dispatch workflows by scriptPath; in a session or agent without Read they are refused and the inline script is the fallback.

features.description: Subagents preload at most 32 skills from the skills field, each once.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed subagents to preload at most 32 skills from the `skills` field, each once; a subagent with the Skill tool can still invoke the rest
features.ork_disposition_note: The longest ork agent skills list has 13 entries (frontend-ui-developer).

features.description: Subagents in their own linked worktree see their own git branch, status and commits, not the parent's.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed subagents in their own linked worktree being shown the parent session's git branch, status and recent commits
features.ork_disposition_note: Free upside for ork's 25 isolation: worktree agents.

features.description: Commands and hooks in background sessions no longer inherit FORCE_COLOR=3.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed commands and hooks in background sessions inheriting `FORCE_COLOR=3`, which put color escape codes into the output Claude reads
features.ork_disposition_note: Free upside: no ANSI codes in ork hook output read in background sessions.

features.description: An async SessionStart hook's unchanged context is no longer added again on every resume.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed an async SessionStart hook's unchanged context being added to the conversation again on every resume
features.ork_disposition_note: Free upside for ork's SessionStart context hooks.

features.description: The Read tool takes allow_large to read a text file past the usual size limits in one call.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added an `allow_large` option to the Read tool so Claude can read a text file past the usual size limits in one call when it needs the whole file and the context has room
features.ork_disposition_note: Follow-up (hook code): pretool/read/tldr-summary.ts still injects a summary on an allow_large whole-file read; the skip is on branch fix/ork10-stack-3-tldr-allow-large (not merged). Not in this PR.

features.description: /cost, the status line, the max budget flag and SDK cost price Sonnet 5.5 cache reads at $0.10 per MTok (was $0.20).
features.reference_changelog_line: Updated `/cost`, the status line, `--max-budget-usd` and the SDK's cost figures to price Sonnet 5.5 cache reads at $0.10 per million tokens (was $0.20)
features.ork_disposition_note: Follow-up (vocab): models.vocab.json still prices claude-sonnet-5-5 cache reads at 0.2; the fix is on branch fix/ork10-stack-1-sonnet55-cache-price (not merged). Not in this PR.

features.description: The default limit on MCP tool descriptions sent up front and on MCP server instructions rises from 2,048 to 4,096 characters.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed the default limit on MCP tool descriptions sent up front and on MCP server instructions from 2,048 to 4,096 characters
features.ork_disposition_note: Documented in configure/references/cc-version-settings.md. The CONTRIBUTING-SKILLS.md line is updated on branch docs/ork10-stack-2-mcp-desc-limit.

features.description: CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_SUBAGENT_MODEL runs every workflow agent on one model while other subagents keep theirs.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_SUBAGENT_MODEL` to run every workflow agent on one model while other subagents keep theirs
features.ork_disposition_note: Documented in configure/references/cc-version-settings.md. 6 of 8 ork workflow scripts pass a per-stage model; which wins against the variable is unconfirmed.

features.description: autoCompactWindow is allowed in subagent frontmatter and in agents flag definitions, so a subagent can auto-compact earlier than the main window.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `autoCompactWindow` to subagent frontmatter and `--agents` definitions, so a subagent can auto-compact earlier than the main conversation's window
features.ork_disposition_note: Documented in configure/references/cc-version-settings.md. No ork agent sets it; whether plugin agents honour the key is unconfirmed.

features.description: CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS sets a longer maximum backoff for 529 retries.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS` environment variable to set a longer maximum delay for the backoff when retrying an overloaded (529) request
features.ork_disposition_note: Documented in configure/references/cc-version-settings.md beside the 2.1.292 base-delay variable.

features.description: Debug output names unrecognized frontmatter fields in custom agent files, with a typo hint.
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved `--debug` output to name unrecognized frontmatter fields in custom agent files, with a hint for likely typos
features.ork_disposition_note: Follow-up: one debug run over ork's 36 agents is a cheap check of which frontmatter keys CC actually reads.

features.description: /plugin notes a plugin whose hooks are left out because another enabled plugin has the same name.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added a note in `/plugin` on a plugin whose hooks are left out because another enabled plugin has the same name
features.ork_disposition_note: Free diagnostic for users who enable two ork channels at once.

features.description: Esc during a UserPromptSubmit hook or a mod's prompt.submit hook no longer ends headless sessions, clears the prompt or lets the unchecked prompt through.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed Esc or an interrupt during a `UserPromptSubmit` hook or a mod's `prompt.submit` hook ending headless sessions, clearing the typed prompt, or letting the unchecked prompt through
features.ork_disposition_note: Free upside: ork's UserPromptSubmit hooks can no longer be bypassed by an interrupt.

features.description: Token counts for Haiku 5.5 and other adaptive-thinking-only models are fixed.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed token counts for Haiku 5.5 and other models that take only adaptive thinking, which failed behind some gateways and were counted with budget thinking elsewhere
features.ork_disposition_note: Free upside for haiku-pinned ork agents once the alias moves (#4661).

features.description: The Workflow tool accepts script files with CRLF line endings.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed the Workflow tool refusing script files with CRLF line endings, such as files checked out on Windows
features.ork_disposition_note: Free upside for Windows users of ork's workflow scripts.

features.description: Debug output for command hooks logs command, plugin, outcome and duration when they finish.
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved `--debug` output for hooks: command hooks on tool calls, prompts, SessionStart and Stop now log their command, plugin, outcome and duration when they finish, so a slow hook is identifiable
features.ork_disposition_note: Free diagnostic that complements ork's hook-timing telemetry.

features.description: Managed-settings PreToolUse hooks that deny with continue: false, and managed prompt hooks that block, now end the turn.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed managed-settings `PreToolUse` hooks that deny a tool call with `"continue": false`, and managed `prompt` hooks that block one, refusing the call but not ending the turn
features.ork_disposition_note: ork hooks are plugin hooks, not managed settings; nothing to change.

features.description: claude -p and Python Agent SDK sessions on third-party providers or with telemetry off start in auto mode when no permission mode is configured; --permission-mode still overrides.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed `claude -p` and Python Agent SDK sessions on third-party providers or with telemetry off to start in auto mode when no permission mode is configured, like interactive sessions; `--permission-mode` still overrides it
features.ork_disposition_note: Documented in configure/references/cc-version-settings.md beside the 2.1.284 interactive auto-mode default. Harnesses keep explicit permission modes.

features.description: claude mcp get hides command, arguments and environment values of stdio MCP servers provided by plugins; variable names are still shown.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed `claude mcp get` to hide the command, arguments, and environment values of stdio MCP servers provided by plugins; variable names are still shown
features.ork_disposition_note: Documented in doctor/rules/mcp-status-checks.md: a redacted value is unmeasured, not a missing credential.

features.description: Managed allowedProviders limits which API providers a machine may use (Anthropic API, custom endpoint, Bedrock, Mantle, Vertex, Foundry, Claude Platform on AWS, Cloud gateway).
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `allowedProviders` managed setting to limit which API providers a machine may use
features.ork_disposition_note: Managed orgs only. An ork agent pinned to an alias whose provider is delisted fails the same way as under deniedModels (2.1.283 row).

features.description: claude plugin configure <plugin> shows a plugin's options and which are unset, or saves values read from stdin with --values-stdin.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `claude plugin configure <plugin>` to show a plugin's options and which are unset, or save new values read from stdin with `values-stdin`
features.ork_disposition_note: Scriptable plugin option surface; folds into GH-4054 richer plugin health output.

features.description: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WEB_FETCH turns off the WebFetch tool.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WEB_FETCH` environment variable to turn off the WebFetch tool
features.ork_disposition_note: Operator knob; ork ships no env config.

features.description: Background Bash and PowerShell commands stop after a time limit (their timeout with run_in_background, default 30 min, max 2 h); Claude is notified.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed background Bash and PowerShell commands to stop after a time limit (their `timeout` with `run_in_background`, default 30 min, max 2 h); Claude is notified when one is stopped
features.ork_disposition_note: ork hooks and agents run background commands. Scoped to unattended sessions only in 2.1.288, which resolves the interactive case.

features.description: Hooks and SDK permission callbacks no longer see a missing or outdated plan on ExitPlanMode when the plan was written in the same response.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed hooks and SDK permission callbacks seeing a missing or outdated plan on ExitPlanMode when the plan was written in the same response
features.ork_disposition_note: ork registers no ExitPlanMode hook; corrects the input ork permission callbacks would read.

features.description: Synchronous hooks no longer hang Claude Code while a background process the hook started kept its output open; the hook finishes shortly after its own process exits.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed synchronous hooks hanging Claude Code while a background process the hook started (for example `some-daemon &`) kept its output open; the hook now finishes shortly after its own process exits
features.ork_disposition_note: Free reliability fix across ork's command-hook fleet; no daemon-spawning hook exists to change.

features.description: An MCP tool that sets its own _meta['anthropic/alwaysLoad'] to false stays deferred when its --mcp-config, Agent SDK or plugin server is set to alwaysLoad.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed MCP tools so a tool that sets its own `_meta['anthropic/alwaysLoad']` to false stays deferred when its `--mcp-config`, Agent SDK or plugin server is set to `alwaysLoad`
features.ork_disposition_note: Per-tool deferral now beats the server-level alwaysLoad the doctor alwaysLoad audit recommends; a tool that opts out is not a finding.

features.description: When project or user skills include one named verify, Claude is told to run it right before committing, except docs-only and tests-only commits.
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved commit guidance: when your project or user skills include one named `verify`, Claude is now told to run it right before committing, except for docs-only and tests-only commits
features.ork_disposition_note: ork ships a verify skill, so CC's built-in commit guidance now names it. Check its triggers and outputs before changing invocation docs.

features.description: --bare now connects only the MCP servers named on the command line, sends the model no system reminders and starts no background tasks; a shell command reaching its timeout stops instead of moving to the background.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed `--bare` to connect only the MCP servers named on the command line, send the model no system reminders, and start no background tasks; under `--bare`, a shell command that reaches its timeout now stops instead of moving to the background
features.ork_disposition_note: ork's bare-eval harness relies on --bare minimalism; the timeout change alters long-running eval commands.

features.description: API 400 errors after a tool or hook returned an object, number or boolean instead of text are fixed, including in resumed sessions.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed API 400 errors after a tool or hook returned an object, number or boolean instead of text, including in resumed sessions
features.ork_disposition_note: ork hooks emit JSON text already; this removes a whole failure class for any non-conforming hook output.

features.description: When the Anthropic API refuses the model a default or alias resolves to, Claude Code retries once on the previous model of the same tier instead of failing every turn.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed every turn failing when the Anthropic API refuses the model your default or a model alias resolves to: Claude Code now retries once on the previous model of the same tier
features.ork_disposition_note: ork agents pin aliases that advance upstream (sonnet -> sonnet-5-5); a refused new target now falls back instead of breaking the session.

features.description: Subagents spawned with worktree isolation no longer load the project CLAUDE.md and its imports a second time from the worktree copy on their first file read.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed subagents spawned with worktree isolation loading the project CLAUDE.md and its imports a second time from the worktree copy on their first file read
features.ork_disposition_note: ork runs 25 isolation:worktree agents; the double-load wasted context on every first read.

features.description: MCP error messages no longer show a credential's value, percent-encoded Bearer tokens are fully masked, secrets with invisible characters stay redacted, and URL passwords with punctuation are masked.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed MCP error messages showing a credential's value when "Bearer" or "Basic" came before its key name
features.ork_disposition_note: Four redaction fixes on the log/transcript surface ork's doctor reads; nothing to ship.

features.description: claude mcp list and claude mcp get no longer print escape sequences from server names and values, and stdio servers without a type field show Type, Command, Args and Environment again.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed `claude mcp list` and `claude mcp get`, and the not-found error of `claude mcp remove`, `login` and `logout`, printing line breaks and terminal escape sequences from MCP server names and values
features.ork_disposition_note: Cleaner input for doctor's claude mcp list parsing.

features.description: Claude Mods are announced: plugins may now modify deeper behavior.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added Claude Mods: plugins may now modify deeper behavior
features.ork_disposition_note: ork ships four module-based mods (lesson-cards, memory-lens, promote-lights, secrets-veil). Measured 2026-10-03 on 2.1.288 headless (-p --plugin-dir per mod, flag unset then set): all four load and fire with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS unset (secrets-veil masked a tool result, lesson-cards denied gh pr checks via cancelled-check-is-not-pass, memory-lens indexed 384 memories, promote-lights ran gh via $.process.run). The flag gates 2.1.266 to 2.1.286 only. Watch stays for the built-in You should know coexistence and GH-3917 (draft A4).

features.description: You should know, a built-in mod where a side agent flags things you or Claude might miss; /plugin enable cc-plugin-you-should-know@builtin (first-party sessions with telemetry on).
features.reference_changelog_line: Added You should know, a built-in mod where a side agent watches your back and flags things you or Claude might miss. Turn it on with `/plugin enable cc-plugin-you-should-know@builtin` (for first-party sessions with telemetry on)
features.ork_disposition_note: Optional built-in mod; check coexistence with ork's mods, do not enable it by default.

features.description: URL prompts from MCP servers on the 2025-11-25 protocol; a server that no longer connects after the update needs "bareElicitationCapability": true in its MCP config entry.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added URL prompts from MCP servers on the 2025-11-25 protocol, for example to sign in. If a server no longer connects after this update, add "bareElicitationCapability": true to its MCP config entry
features.ork_disposition_note: Doctor's MCP checks should know the recovery key when a server stops connecting on 2.1.287+.

features.description: prompt_text joins the OpenTelemetry user_prompt event as a copy of prompt for backends that nest dotted keys; drop or mask it wherever prompt is dropped or masked.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `prompt_text` to the OpenTelemetry `user_prompt` event, a copy of `prompt` for backends that nest dotted keys; drop or mask it wherever you drop or mask `prompt`
features.ork_disposition_note: ork ships no OTEL config; a masking note for operators who export telemetry.

features.description: Hooks configured with asyncRewake no longer wake Claude repeatedly with "found issues" notifications when the hook's script file is missing; the broken hook is reported once.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed hooks configured with `asyncRewake` waking Claude over and over with "found issues" notifications when the hook's script file is missing; the broken hook is now reported once
features.ork_disposition_note: ork registers no asyncRewake hooks; the fix quiets a notification loop for operators who add their own.

features.description: A dangerous rm no longer loses its always-ask safeguard when the same command redirects output to a ~ or wildcard path.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed a dangerous `rm` (such as one on `/` or the home directory) losing its always-ask safeguard when the same command also redirected output to a `~` or wildcard path
features.ork_disposition_note: Closes an escape on the dangerous-rm class security-patterns documents; free hardening beside ork's deny payload.

features.description: SessionStart hooks from synced plugins now run in new cloud sessions.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed SessionStart hooks from synced plugins not running in new cloud sessions
features.ork_disposition_note: ork registers ~15 SessionStart hooks; they now fire in cloud sessions for operators who sync the plugin from claude.ai.

features.description: Whole-tool Bash allow rules and allowing hooks now prompt for, not run, shell writes to files Claude Code's file tools refuse outright (the Anthropic profile store, the host credentials file).
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed whole-tool `Bash` allow rules and allowing hooks to prompt for, not run, shell writes to files Claude Code's file tools refuse outright (the Anthropic profile store, the host credentials file)
features.ork_disposition_note: A Bash allow rule can no longer route around the credential-store refusal; converges with ork's guards.

features.description: $.ui.selection() for mods returns the text last selected in fullscreen mode and, when the selection lies within one transcript row, that row.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `$.ui.selection()` for mods: returns the text you last selected in fullscreen mode and, when the selection lies within one transcript row, that row
features.ork_disposition_note: New mod API surface for ork's four module-based mods once the A4 contract check lands.

features.description: Session titles, memory recall and prompt hooks failing on Mantle or behind gateways that reject structured outputs are fixed; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_STRUCTURED_OUTPUTS turns structured outputs off.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed session titles, memory recall and prompt hooks failing on Mantle or behind gateways that reject structured outputs; added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_STRUCTURED_OUTPUTS` to turn structured outputs off
features.ork_disposition_note: Named in configure/references/cc-version-settings.md: the opt-out for gateway deployments whose prompt hooks failed on structured-output requests.

features.description: Agent teams: a plugin-defined agent spawned by name now runs with its own prompt, tools, disallowedTools and effort instead of the defaults.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed agent teams: a plugin-defined agent spawned by name now runs with its own prompt, tools, disallowedTools and effort instead of the defaults
features.ork_disposition_note: All 36 ork agents declared custom config that was silently dropped on team spawns; the fix lands for free.

features.description: PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hooks are no longer skipped when matching them failed or the tool's input could not be serialized to JSON; the call is now blocked.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hooks being skipped when matching them failed or the tool's input could not be serialized to JSON; the call is now blocked
features.ork_disposition_note: Fail-closed on the two hook events ork's guards live on; a skipped guard was a silent pass before.

features.description: A plugin's tool.call hook no longer makes Bash fail and file searches read the wrong folder in subagents that run in a worktree.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed a plugin's `tool.call` hook making Bash fail and file searches read the wrong folder in subagents that run in a worktree
features.ork_disposition_note: ork's mods register tool.call hooks and ork spawns worktree-isolated subagents; the two surfaces overlapped.

features.description: git-subdir plugin installs no longer fail or cache an incomplete plugin on git older than 2.39 (e.g. Ubuntu 22.04's 2.34).
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed `git-subdir` plugin installs failing, or caching an incomplete plugin, on older git (before 2.39, e.g. Ubuntu 22.04's 2.34)
features.ork_disposition_note: ork's marketplace ships two git-subdir entries; installs on older git now work.

features.description: The InstructionsLoaded hook no longer omits agent_id and agent_type when a subagent's file access loads a rule or nested CLAUDE.md; rules and nested CLAUDE.md files loaded on file access now also report effort.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed the InstructionsLoaded hook omitting agent_id and agent_type when a subagent's file access loads a rule or nested CLAUDE.md; rules and nested CLAUDE.md files loaded on file access now also report effort
features.ork_disposition_note: ork registers InstructionsLoaded hooks; the payload fields they log are complete on file-access loads.

features.description: Path-scoped .claude/rules and nested CLAUDE.md files now load when Write or Edit creates or changes a file in their scope; previously only Read loaded them.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed path-scoped `.claude/rules` and nested CLAUDE.md files not loading when Write or Edit creates or changes a file in their scope (previously only Read loaded them)
features.ork_disposition_note: ork ships 10 path-scoped rules; a write into their scope now loads them like a read did.

features.description: The background command time limit now applies only in unattended sessions (-p, Agent SDK, CI, cloud); terminal, desktop app and VS Code sessions have no limit.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed the background command time limit to apply only in unattended sessions (`-p`, Agent SDK, CI, cloud); terminal, desktop app and VS Code sessions have no limit
features.ork_disposition_note: Narrows the 2.1.285 limit: interactive sessions are unbounded again, headless ork harnesses keep the 30 min default ceiling.

features.description: The client-side auto mode classifier ignores an ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL pin that names Claude Sonnet 5.5 or Opus 5.5 and uses Claude Sonnet 5 instead.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed the client-side auto mode classifier to ignore an `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL` pin that names Claude Sonnet 5.5 or Opus 5.5 and use Claude Sonnet 5 instead
features.ork_disposition_note: Classifier-side only; ork's sonnet alias mapping to claude-sonnet-5-5 is unaffected but the pin no longer steers auto mode.

features.description: A dangerous rm inside a bash -c or sh -c script no longer runs without a prompt in bypassPermissions mode or under a shell allow rule.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed a dangerous `rm` (such as one on `/` or the home directory) inside a `bash -c` or `sh -c` script running without a prompt in bypassPermissions mode or under a shell allow rule
features.ork_disposition_note: Second 2.1.x closure of a subshell-carrier for dangerous rm; the class security-patterns documents.

features.description: claude plugin install for GitHub-source plugins on machines with no GitHub SSH key now falls back to HTTPS and prints a notice.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed `claude plugin install` failing for GitHub-source plugins on macOS and Linux machines with no GitHub SSH key: the clone now falls back to HTTPS and prints a notice
features.ork_disposition_note: Removes an install-time failure for ork's GitHub marketplace source.

features.description: mcp_tool hooks on blocking events now wait for a connecting MCP server instead of being skipped.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed `mcp_tool` hooks on blocking events (PreToolUse and similar) being skipped while their MCP server was still connecting; they now wait for it, up to the MCP connect timeout
features.ork_disposition_note: ork ships only type:command hooks (0 mcp_tool hooks in src/hooks/hooks.json), so nothing was being skipped.

features.description: settings.json accepts "attribution": false to hide commit and PR attribution; older CLIs skip a file holding it.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `"attribution": false` in `settings.json` to hide all commit and PR attribution; older CLI versions skip a settings file that holds it, so keep the object form in files shared across versions
features.ork_disposition_note: ork ships no attribution setting; the object form stays the portable choice below 2.1.281.

features.description: claude plugin validate reports .mcp.json entries dropped at load, undeclared user_config refs and insecure URLs.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added MCP server checks to `claude plugin validate`: it reports `.mcp.json` entries that would be silently dropped at load, undeclared `${user_config.*}` references, and insecure URLs
features.ork_disposition_note: Free extra coverage for the CC Plugin Validate CI job; ork ships no .mcp.json in the plugin.

features.description: Repo, user and --add-dir skills lose allowed-tools pre-approval under managed allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed repository, user and `--add-dir` skills, commands and skills-directory plugin manifests pre-approving their own tools via `allowed-tools` under managed `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`
features.ork_disposition_note: Only managed orgs. Inventory in doctor/references/skill-preapproval.md (93 of 107 skills pre-grant a prompt-gated tool), CI drift gate tests/skills/structure/test-skill-preapproval-inventory.mjs.

features.description: Bash rules with a mid-pattern :* were skipped in settings files; now applied from every source with a startup warning.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed Bash permission rules with a mid-pattern `:*` being skipped in settings files while `--allowedTools` honored them; they now work from every source, with a startup warning on how they match
features.ork_disposition_note: Shipped operator payload has no mid-pattern :* rule (space form since v3, #3849). payload-coverage.py now refuses the shape because the 2.1.277 floor still skips it; pinned by tests/ci/test-payload-colon-star.sh.

features.description: Project and local settings ignore OTEL variables that turn on export, set the endpoint or capture content.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed project and local settings to ignore OpenTelemetry variables that turn on export, set its endpoint, or capture content, like `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY` and `OTEL_LOG_*`
features.ork_disposition_note: ork ships no OTEL settings.

features.description: maxProseWidth caps prose width in wide terminals.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added a `maxProseWidth` setting that caps the width of Claude's prose in wide terminals while tables and code blocks keep the full width
features.ork_disposition_note: Operator preference; nothing for ork to ship.

features.description: Managed deniedModels and availableModelsMatch:"exact" block specific models or unlisted versions.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `deniedModels` managed setting to block specific models, even when `availableModels` allows them
features.ork_disposition_note: ork agents pin model aliases (#4541 sonnet row); under availableModelsMatch exact a new alias target is blocked until listed. Documented in the matrix row, no code.

features.description: /doctor prompt-audit audits CLAUDE.md, skills, agents and commands for prompting patterns written for older models.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `/doctor prompt-audit` (also `/checkup prompt-audit`) to audit your CLAUDE.md files, skills, agents and commands for prompting patterns written for older models
features.ork_disposition_note: Candidate input for ork skill hygiene; not wired.

features.description: MCP, WebFetch and WebSearch outputs join the tool.output OTel span event under OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT=1.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added MCP tool, WebFetch and WebSearch outputs to the `tool.output` OpenTelemetry span event when `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT=1`
features.ork_disposition_note: ork ships no OTEL config.

features.description: --plugin-dir load failures in stream-json plugin_errors now carry path.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `path` to `--plugin-dir` load-failure entries in the stream-json `system/init` `plugin_errors`, naming the directory that did not load
features.ork_disposition_note: Free for headless harnesses reading plugin_errors.

features.description: {"decision":"block"} from Elicitation and ElicitationResult hooks now declines the MCP elicitation, as exit code 2 does.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed `{"decision":"block"}` returned by Elicitation and ElicitationResult hooks being ignored; it now declines the MCP elicitation, as exit code 2 does
features.ork_disposition_note: elicitation/elicitation-guard now returns decision:block + reason alongside continue:false (the floor 2.1.277 ignores decision). Tests: elicitation-guard.test.ts, output-guard-cc-contract.test.ts.

features.description: Marketplace, claude.ai and npm plugins lose allowed-tools pre-approval under managed allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly unless the source is official or vouched for.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed plugins from marketplaces, claude.ai and npm pre-approving their own tools via `allowed-tools` under managed `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`; only plugins from an official Anthropic source or a source that managed settings vouch for keep that pre-approval
features.ork_disposition_note: ork is a marketplace plugin. Same inventory as 2.1.282. The managed key that vouches for a source is not named in the docs (unconfirmed).

features.description: claude-sonnet-5-5 is the default Sonnet on the Anthropic API: 1M context, $2/$10, cache reads $0.20.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added Claude Sonnet 5.5 (`claude-sonnet-5-5`), now the default Sonnet model on the Anthropic API — 1M context, $2/$10 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads
features.ork_disposition_note: Adopted in orchestkit#4541 (models.vocab.json sonnet row and matrix row "Sonnet 5.5 default model").

features.description: Interactive terminal and VS Code sessions start in auto mode when no permission mode is configured.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed interactive terminal and VS Code sessions to start in auto mode when no permission mode is configured, on every plan and provider; `permissions.defaultMode` still overrides it
features.ork_disposition_note: Changes when ork PreToolUse guards see a prompt vs a classifier verdict; permissions.defaultMode still overrides.

features.description: /mcp reconnect all retries every failed or unauthenticated MCP server.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `/mcp reconnect all` in the interactive terminal to retry every MCP server that failed to connect or needs authentication at once
features.ork_disposition_note: Name in doctor MCP remediation later.

features.description: claude-opus-5-5 is the default Opus model: 1M context, $4/$20 per MTok, cache reads $0.20/MTok.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added Claude Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`), now the default Opus model — 1M context, $4/$20 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads
features.ork_disposition_note: models.vocab.json: opus alias -> claude-opus-5-5, fullIds + pricing (cache write 5.00 at the vocab's 1.25x ratio). Without the row cost-estimator billed Opus 5.5 at the claude-sonnet-5 fallback. tests/ci/claude-model-ids.txt gains claude-opus-5-5 (and the missing claude-opus-5). model-recency-scan.py date-snapshot exemption fixed so the gate sees claude-opus-5 as superseded; 24 live Opus 5 claims retargeted.

features.description: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH changes the 2,048-character cap on MCP tool descriptions and server instructions.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH` to change the 2,048-character cap on MCP tool descriptions and server instructions for every MCP server in the session
features.ork_disposition_note: Named in CONTRIBUTING-SKILLS.md (the fixed-2KB claim) and configure/references/cc-version-settings.md. Keep the default.

features.description: hook_execution_complete OTel event carries hook output sizes and the oversized-output count.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added hook output sizes and the number of oversized outputs saved to a file to the `hook_execution_complete` OpenTelemetry event
features.ork_disposition_note: ork ships no OTel config; worth reading when measuring ork's hook output volume. Upstream monitoring doc does not yet list the attributes (claude-code-guide, 404).

features.description: PermissionRequest no longer runs agent-type hooks; shows an error pointing to command or http hooks.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed `PermissionRequest` hooks: an agent-type hook no longer runs there, since its answer could never allow or deny the request; it now shows an error pointing to command or http hooks
features.ork_disposition_note: All four PermissionRequest hooks in src/hooks/hooks.json are type command (verified).

features.description: A pre-per-model saved effort no longer applies to newly released models such as Opus 5.5; Opus 4.7/4.8 and Fable 5 stop holding launch-default effort over settings.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed an effort level saved before `/effort` became per-model to no longer apply to newly released models such as Opus 5.5; they start at their default until you pick a level
features.ork_disposition_note: audit-full and verify now say to pass high or xhigh (Opus 5.5 API default is medium per the claude-api skill). Frontmatter effort stays tracked in GH-4052.

features.description: Marketplaces imitating a reserved name are refused or stop loading.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed plugin marketplaces whose name imitates a reserved marketplace name to be refused when added, and to stop loading if one was already added
features.ork_disposition_note: ork's marketplace name is `orchestkit`.

features.description: Resumed fork subagents re-send their first tool list, keeping prompt caching.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed resumed fork subagents rebuilding their tool list instead of re-sending the one they first used, which broke prompt caching for that agent
features.ork_disposition_note: Benefits the context: fork pattern with no ork change.

features.description: Writes through a symlink are judged where they land.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed writes through a symlinked path being judged by their in-tree spelling: the prompt names where the write lands, and `acceptEdits`, allow rules and auto mode no longer approve one landing outside
features.ork_disposition_note: Closes a class security-patterns documents; no ork change.

features.description: Auto mode on Claude API, Enterprise, Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and gateways defaults to the server-side classifier; CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0 opts out.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed auto mode for Claude API and Enterprise users, and on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and gateways, to default to the server-side classifier, which does not charge for classifier overhead (`CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` opts out on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and gateways); warns on billed fallback. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/auto-mode-classifier-billing
features.ork_disposition_note: Recorded in configure/references/cc-version-settings.md and the doctor matrix 2.1.278 row; reverses the 2.1.273 note. ork sets neither value.

features.description: /status shows an Auto mode server row.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added an `Auto mode server` row to `/status` showing whether this session's auto mode classifier runs on the server
features.ork_disposition_note: CC UI only.

features.description: Bash commands the permission checker cannot fully analyze no longer skip the prompt under permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories, and a subshell can no longer hide a dangerous rm in bypass mode.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed Bash commands the permission checker cannot fully analyze skipping the prompt under `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories`, and a subshell hiding a dangerous `rm` in bypass mode
features.ork_disposition_note: Two silent-bypass classes on the exact key ork documents (adopted in the 2.1.252-257 wave) close without an ork change. Free.

features.description: The 2.1.268 change that checked Read and Edit deny rules on unanalyzable Bash lines (eval, env -C) is reverted; such commands prompt again instead of being denied.
features.reference_changelog_line: Reverted a 2.1.268 change that checked Read and Edit deny rules on Bash lines the permission checker can't analyze (`eval`, `env -C`); commands like `time -p make build` prompt again instead of being denied
features.ork_disposition_note: Narrows a change recorded in the 2.1.268 matrix row one release later. Recorded so a future reader does not over-credit the 2.1.268 deny-rule coverage.

features.description: Sub-agents and background agents are no longer reported as failed with their result never delivered when the final streamed reply omitted token usage or a model id.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed sub-agents and background agents being reported as failed, with their result never delivered, when the final streamed reply omitted token usage or carried no model id
features.ork_disposition_note: ork's subagent-stop family consumes subagent results; a silently dropped result read as a failed agent. Free fix, no ork change.

features.description: Saved scheduled tasks no longer run in the wrong session after .claude/scheduled_tasks.json is copied into another folder such as a new worktree.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed saved scheduled tasks running in the wrong session after `.claude/scheduled_tasks.json` was copied into another folder, such as a new worktree
features.ork_disposition_note: ork's .worktrees/<task> convention copies a full checkout including .claude/, so this was a live wrong-session hazard on every fresh worktree. Free fix.

features.description: Hook progress and sub-agent activity no longer re-process the whole conversation on every update in long sessions.
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved responsiveness in long sessions: hook progress and sub-agent activity no longer re-process the whole conversation on every update
features.ork_disposition_note: ork registers 152 classic hooks, the heaviest hook surface in the estate, so every long ork session paid this reprocessing cost. Free perf win.

features.description: CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS=1 sends five x-claude-code-* request headers for LLM gateways.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `x-claude-code-request-class`, `x-claude-code-agent-type`, `x-claude-code-prev-tool-durations`, `x-claude-code-compaction` and `x-claude-code-context-compacted` request headers for LLM gateways; opt in with `CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS=1`
features.ork_disposition_note: Zero gateway keys across src/, manifests/ and shared/. Operator setting only.

features.description: http MCP servers that only speak legacy HTTP+SSE no longer fail on a 4xx first answer, Streamable HTTP calls honor a per-server timeout past the old 5 minute cap, and list-changed notifications without listChanged now refresh prompts and resources.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed MCP servers configured as `http` that only speak legacy HTTP+SSE failing to connect when they answer the first request with 422 or another 4xx error
features.ork_disposition_note: Three transport-level fixes on the surface ork's mcp-config docs cover. Free.

features.description: Worktree-isolated sessions now refuse Bash commands carrying certain nested shell expansions that were previously accepted.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed worktree-isolated sessions accepting Bash commands with certain nested shell expansions; these are now refused
features.ork_disposition_note: Closes a containment escape on the 25 isolation:worktree agents. The mirror-image of the 2.1.260 fix that un-broke legitimate loops; this one removes acceptance that should never have been granted.

features.description: CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS bounds how long the first non-interactive turn waits for connecting MCP servers; 0 skips the wait.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS` to bound how long the first non-interactive turn waits for connecting MCP servers (`0` = don't wait)
features.ork_disposition_note: Direct knob for ork's headless harnesses that pair -p with outer timeouts. Deferred because a plugin cannot ship env defaults and the floor cannot assume it.

features.description: Stop prompt hooks no longer re-send their whole prompt on every block; repeat blocks name the condition in a 500-character label.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed Stop prompt hooks re-sending their whole prompt on every block in a conversation; repeat blocks now name the condition with a 500-character label
features.ork_disposition_note: ork registers 8 Stop hooks, all async and non-blocking, so ork never paid this cost; it matters for operator-added blocking Stop hooks on top of ork.

features.description: Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and telemetry-disabled installs move to the v2 MCP client and MCP 2026-07-28 negotiation by default; MCP_SDK_GENERATION=v1 or MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy opt out.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and telemetry-disabled installs to use the v2 MCP client and MCP 2026-07-28 negotiation with direct HTTP servers by default, as other installs already do (opt out: `MCP_SDK_GENERATION=v1` or `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy`)
features.ork_disposition_note: Protocol-level change on the MCP surface. ork's first-party install already ran v2; this aligns the remaining install classes. Worth knowing when a Foundry MCP server misbehaves only on one install class.

features.description: MCP connection errors and the MCP login tool description no longer display secrets resolved from ${VAR} placeholders in MCP configs.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed MCP connection errors and the MCP login tool's description showing secrets resolved from `${VAR}` placeholders in MCP configs
features.ork_disposition_note: A credential-display fix on the config shape ork recommends (${VAR} placeholders rather than literals). Free.

features.description: Skills and plugins enabled on a claude.ai account now sync into terminal sessions signed in with it, with syncClaudeAiSkills:false and syncClaudeAiPlugins:false opt-outs.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added syncing of the skills and plugins enabled on your claude.ai account to terminal sessions signed in with it; opt out with `syncClaudeAiSkills: false` or `syncClaudeAiPlugins: false`
features.ork_disposition_note: A new distribution channel beside the marketplace: account-level plugins can now shadow or duplicate the repo-installed ork. Worth a configure note; deferred because the operator-facing text belongs with the other sync settings, not this lane.

features.description: Plugin messages, logs and claude plugin marketplace list no longer display a password or token stored in a git, ssh or marketplace URL.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed plugin and marketplace messages, logs and `claude plugin marketplace list` showing a password or token stored in a git, ssh or marketplace URL
features.ork_disposition_note: Credential-display fix on the marketplace surface ork itself is published through. Free.

features.description: Plugins installed from an npm source are fetched with npm pack --ignore-scripts and integrity-verified, so a package's install scripts no longer run.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed plugins installed from an npm source to be fetched with `npm pack --ignore-scripts` and integrity-verified, so a package's install scripts no longer run
features.ork_disposition_note: Supply-chain hardening on a distribution channel ork could adopt later; today ork ships via git marketplace and archive, not npm. Free hardening either way.

features.description: Plugin reload previews no longer replace a running session's extracted plugin files when the plugin was loaded from a --plugin-dir or --plugin-url archive.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed plugin reload previews replacing a running session's extracted plugin files when the plugin was loaded from a `--plugin-dir` or `--plugin-url` archive
features.ork_disposition_note: Hits ork's own dev loop, which loads the plugin via --plugin-dir. A preview silently clobbering the live extraction read as a broken local build. Free fix.

features.description: SubagentStop hooks with a specific matcher no longer fire for every stopping subagent whose agent type is empty.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed `SubagentStop` hooks with a specific `matcher` firing for every stopping subagent whose agent type was empty
features.ork_disposition_note: Verified no-op for ork: the single SubagentStop block in src/hooks/hooks.json carries no matcher and 6 hooks, so they already fired for every subagent by design.

features.description: --forward-subagent-text stream-json and SDK output no longer drops messages of subagents spawned by a context:fork skill or of nested forked skills.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed `--forward-subagent-text` stream-json and SDK output dropping the messages of subagents spawned by a `context: fork` skill, and of forked skills invoked by a subagent or another forked skill
features.ork_disposition_note: ork documents the context:fork spawn pattern in chain-patterns/references/fork-pattern.md; lost messages read as silent subagents. Free fix.

features.description: Every request failed with 400 Input tag 'advisor_20260301' when ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL pointed at a proxy or gateway; fixed as a 2.1.275 regression.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed every request failing with `400 ... Input tag 'advisor_20260301'` when `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` points at a proxy or gateway (2.1.275 regression)
features.ork_disposition_note: ork ships no ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL itself but documents proxied setups (dev-agent-lens LiteLLM, model-selection gateway note). On exactly 2.1.275 those documented setups fail every request; 2.1.276 restores them. Conditional no-op, no ork change.

features.description: AGENTS.md support is live with no flag: in a project with no CLAUDE.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md or CLAUDE.local.md on the filesystem-root-to-cwd walk, Claude Code reads AGENTS.md instead, and CLAUDE.md wins when both exist. The built-in agents-md module offers four instructionFiles values (claude-md, claude-md-or-agents-md default, claude-md-and-agents-md, managed-only) under /config 'Project instructions'.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added AGENTS.md support: in a project with no CLAUDE.md, Claude Code reads AGENTS.md instead; change it under "Project instructions" in `/config` (not yet on Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry)
features.ork_disposition_note: Verified on this box 2026-09-18 with the codeword probe checked in as tests/canary/agents-md-fallback.sh: AGENTS.md-only repo answers its codeword; a repo with both files answers the CLAUDE.md word; the flag CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS is not needed for the builtin. Setup docs gained the fallback sentence; the instructionFiles decision (AGENTS.md-as-source vs CLAUDE.md-as-source) stays with the operator.

features.description: The function-hooks engine exposes five hook tiers (prepend, user, append, builtin, core), 92 events (38 lifecycle plus 54 $ ops) and 33 classic.<HookEvent> events mirroring hooks.json names; CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS gates user modules, not builtins. claude plugin test does not exist on 2.1.277.
features.reference_changelog_line: Upstream types/claude-code.d.ts (measured on the 2.1.277 binary 2026-09-18); claude plugin help on this box lists no test subcommand
features.ork_disposition_note: Recorded in the matrix row; no CHANGELOG bullet names the engine. ork ships 3 unwired mods (lesson-cards, secrets-veil, promote-lights) and its vitest harness stays the only runnable mod-test path since claude plugin test is absent on 2.1.277.

features.description: The deprecated TaskOutput tool is removed; Claude reads a background task's output file with Read instead, and taskOutputMaxChars plus TASK_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH are inert.
features.reference_changelog_line: Removed the deprecated TaskOutput tool; Claude reads a background task's output file with Read instead, and the `taskOutputMaxChars` setting and `TASK_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH` no longer have any effect
features.ork_disposition_note: chain-patterns/references/monitor-patterns.md recommended TaskOutput for final reads; the decision table now records the 2.1.277 removal and the Read replacement.

features.description: Project skills from the main repository now load in --worktree sessions even when .claude/skills is untracked.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed project skills from the main repository not loading in `--worktree` sessions when `.claude/skills` is untracked
features.ork_disposition_note: The exact gap ork's .worktrees/<task> convention hits: a worktree's .claude/skills is untracked until first commit, so project skills silently vanished there. Free fix.

features.description: A sandbox.excludedCommands glob no longer exempts an entire compound Bash command when only one part matched; every part must now match.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed a `sandbox.excludedCommands` glob exempting an entire compound Bash command from the sandbox when only one part matched; every part must now match
features.ork_disposition_note: A sandbox-escape class on the surface doctor's sandbox-posture reference documents. Free.

features.description: Subagent results now reach the main agent under a header marking them as subagent output, so a result cannot pass as the session's own instructions.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed subagent results to reach the main agent under a header marking them as subagent output, with the result indented, so text in a subagent's result cannot pass as the session's own instructions
features.ork_disposition_note: Hardens the channel ork's subagent-stop output validators already watch: an injected instruction inside a result is now visibly framed. Free.

features.description: Sessions continued after /clear no longer lose part of their first message when a SessionStart hook prints output, which had caused a full prompt-cache miss.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed sessions continued after `/clear` (restart, `--continue`, `--resume`) missing part of their first message when a SessionStart hook printed output, causing a full prompt-cache miss
features.ork_disposition_note: ork registers SessionStart hooks that print context; every /clear continuation paid a full cache miss. Free fix.

features.description: claude -p and Agent SDK sessions that could hang with no result after an internal error now report the error and exit with code 1.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed `claude -p` and Agent SDK sessions that could hang with no result after an internal error; they now report the error and exit with code 1
features.ork_disposition_note: ork's headless harnesses used to rely on outer timeouts for this hang; now the process fails fast with a real error. Free fix.

features.description: CC 2.1.272 contains only the unenumerated bug fixes and reliability improvements bullet. No named feature requires an ork change.
features.reference_changelog_line: Bug fixes and reliability improvements
features.ork_disposition_note: Matrix and floor triage in GH-4135. No named settings key, hook event, tool or permission change. Feature design and probe work for 2.1.269 and 2.1.271 stays in GH-4135.

features.description: The entire 2.1.263 changelog is one bullet, "Bug fixes and reliability improvements", with no enumerated fixes. Nothing names a settings key, hook event, tool, permission surface, CLI flag or model id.
features.reference_changelog_line: Bug fixes and reliability improvements
features.ork_disposition_note: Content-free by construction, not by omission: upstream published a single unenumerated bullet, so there is nothing to map onto an ork surface. Recorded as an explicit verdict rather than left as an empty features array, so a later reader can tell "triaged, nothing there" from "never triaged". 2.1.262 was never published (the upstream CHANGELOG jumps 2.1.261 to 2.1.263), same shape as the 2.1.192 and 2.1.253-to-2.1.256 gaps.

features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed frontmatter `model:` on custom commands and skills being ignored in interactive sessions
features.description: A skill's or command's frontmatter `model:` was silently ignored in interactive sessions; it now applies.
features.ork_disposition_note: Largest single behaviour change in this wave for ork. VERIFIED 39 of ork's skills declare a model pin: `grep -rl '^model:' src/skills/*/SKILL.md | wc -l` = 39 (sampled: analytics=haiku, assess=sonnet, audit-full=opus, auto=sonnet, brainstorm=sonnet). Before 2.1.259 every one of those pins was inert in an interactive session, so a skill authored to run on haiku ran on whatever the session used. Nothing to change in ork: the pins were already correct and now take effect. Users below the fix keep the old behaviour, which is why ork's floor (2.1.251) still cannot assume it.

features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed auto mode running a turn on a model it doesn't support when a command or skill's frontmatter `model:` named one; the turn now keeps the session model
features.description: Auto mode no longer switches to a frontmatter-named model it cannot support; it keeps the session model instead.
features.ork_disposition_note: Paired with the fix above and bounds it. ork's 39 pinned skills name only opus, sonnet and haiku (`grep -rh '^model:' src/skills/*/SKILL.md | sort -u`), all of which auto mode supports, so ork never triggered the unsupported branch. Free.

features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed concurrent sessions silently reverting each other's `~/.claude.json` changes
features.description: Concurrent sessions no longer clobber each other's ~/.claude.json; workspace trust and MCP/project state survive many parallel sessions.
features.ork_disposition_note: Directly relevant to how this estate is actually run: ListAgents reported 17 peer sessions (4 live interactive) while this lane was open, which is exactly the condition that produced the silent revert. ork ships no fix of its own for it and never could; the shared-state hazard it documents in the worktree rules is narrower (working tree, index, node_modules) than the ~/.claude.json class this closes. Free upside, no ork change.

features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed blocking Stop hooks causing the turn after a block to lose the model's reasoning from that turn and, on some models, miss the prompt cache
features.description: A blocking Stop hook no longer costs the next turn its reasoning and a prompt-cache hit.
features.ork_disposition_note: ork registers 8 Stop hooks (`ls src/hooks/src/stop/`: goal-tracker, handoff-writer, ledger-cleanup, security-scan-aggregator, session-heartbeat-finalizer, session-summary, stop-failure-handler, task-completion-check). VERIFIED none of them blocks: `grep -rn 'process.exit|decision|continue: false|block' src/hooks/src/stop/*.ts` returns only comments and unrelated identifiers (goal-tracker.ts:23 states the contract outright, 'Async: telemetry write only, must not block Stop'), and all Stop entries in src/hooks/hooks.json carry `async: true`. So ork never paid this cost and gains nothing measurable; the fix matters for users who add their own blocking Stop hook on top of ork.

features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed worktree isolation refusing hook-created worktrees on machines where `git rev-parse` fails with a message other than "not a git repository"
features.description: Worktree isolation no longer refuses a hook-created worktree when git rev-parse fails with an unexpected message.
features.ork_disposition_note: ork has both halves of this surface: 25 agents declare `isolation: worktree` (`grep -rl 'isolation: *worktree' src/agents/*.md | wc -l` = 25) and a hook manages worktree lifecycle (`src/hooks/src/lifecycle/sweep-stale-worktrees.ts`, written for #1884). The refusal was environment-dependent, so it was never reproducible here; free upside.

features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed worktree-isolated sessions refusing common Bash loops, xargs pipelines and launcher-wrapped commands that cannot reach the main checkout
features.description: Worktree-isolated sessions stop refusing Bash loops, xargs pipelines and launcher-wrapped commands.
features.ork_disposition_note: Second helping of the same free upgrade already recorded for the 25 isolation:worktree agents in the 2.1.252-257 triage. No ork change.

features.reference_changelog_line: Added `--json` to `claude plugin validate` for a machine-readable validation report
features.description: claude plugin validate gains --json for a machine-readable report.
features.ork_disposition_note: Actionable and small. ork already runs the command in CI at `.github/workflows/plugin-validation.yml:347`, but consumes only its exit code: `claude plugin validate ./plugins/ork 2>&1 || { echo "::warning::claude plugin validate reported issues"; exit 1; }`. A red run therefore says 'reported issues' and nothing about which. With --json the workflow could name the failing entries in the annotation. Deferred rather than adopted because it must not run below ork's floor (2.1.251) without a version guard, and the step already installs an unpinned CC.

features.reference_changelog_line: Added `--permission-prompts none` for unattended headless hosts
features.description: New --permission-prompts none denies anything that would prompt, while the active permission mode keeps deciding.
